description: How much of the user's monthly credit allowance is left: allowance, used, % used, remaining, the date it resets, and any prepaid credits with their expiry dates (used after the monthly allowance, oldest first). Shared across everyone on the same company plan. Also lists what the Free, Professional and Professional Plus plans each include (your_plan marks theirs). Use only when the user asks how much they have left, when they will reset, or what their plan or another plan includes. Free.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

name: get_account_usage
title: Credits left this month
